cases.title: JASSUB actual video replacement and repeated destruction, onDemandRender=true
JASSUB closes the entire bitmap batch after a native draw failure and renders the next frame

limitations: Only the five JASSUB files executed; not the full sixteen-package matrix or remote CI.
Three published WebKit frame-clock failures are historical controls. Candidate Firefox hybrid first-pixel/readback failure remains JASSUB-FIREFOX-OFFSCREEN-01; no changed timeout, retry or waiver.
The platform file contains no JASSUB wrapper/WASM. Native resources in the manifest describe served bytes; actual response records are separate.

Font is a local separately configured asset, not an installed plugin member. Package worker files are fixed unchanged resources; no new upstream build/reproducibility or redistribution approval is claimed.
Bounded rendering/controlled hybrid delivery is not sustained GPU/physical-device/complete license acceptance; PKG-JASSUB-05/06/09 and CI gates remain authoritative.
Source proof covers three wrapper regression cases; native-render historical default is preserved. Generic installed type/runtime acceptance remains core/chapter only.
